rule: worth-having bar: every delta leg must exceed TOL/3 in absolute value (razor-thin = inside TOL/3 = NOT worth having); pooled AND sealed must agree in direction; pooled corroboration required (no single-window sealed shimmer). Same treatment ROSTER and C1 received in 5398e71.

worth_having_check.reason: Pooled ll and auc are razor-thin (inside TOL/3); ECE direction disagreement (pooled improves -0.0072, sealed degrades +0.0065). Matches the ROSTER/A5/AALL single-window-shimmer pattern: sealed-only signal without pooled corroboration.

RAW_ADDED.mechanism: 14 raw per-side columns decompose the 7 diff features into home/away components. The hypothesis was that raw per-side values recover signal the diff encoding discards. The pooled deltas are razor-thin, meaning the diff encoding is not the bottleneck. Per-member sealed movement shows opposing directions: xgboost degrades (ll +0.0156), MLP improves (ll -0.0202) — the signal is member-dependent and cancels in the blend.

RAW_ADDED.same_universe: moot — both pooled legs are razor-thin; universe correction cannot rescue signal that isn't there.
